items.source: Atomically returns and removes the first element of the list stored at the bound key, and pushes the element at the first/last element (head/tail depending on the destinationPosition argument) of the list stored at destination.
items.translation: 原子性地返回并移除绑定键处存储的列表中的第一个元素，并将该元素推送到存储在destination处的列表的开头/末尾（取决于destinationPosition参数）。

items.source: Atomically returns and removes the last element of the list stored at the bound key, and pushes the element at the first/last element (head/tail depending on the destinationPosition argument) of the list stored at destination.
items.translation: 原子性地返回并移除绑定键处存储的列表中的最后一个元素，并将该元素推送到存储在destination处的列表的第一个/最后一个位置（取决于destinationPosition参数）。

items.source: Blocks connection until element available or timeout reached.
items.translation: 阻塞连接，直到元素可用或达到timeout。

items.translation: 按边界键修剪列表，保留 `start` 和 `end` 之间的元素。

items.source: Get elements between start and end from list at the bound key.
items.translation: 从绑定键处的列表中获取 `start` 和 `end` 之间的元素。

items.source: Default implementation for RedisList. Suitable for not just lists, but also queues (FIFO ordering) or stacks (LIFO ordering) and deques (or double ended queues). Allows the maximum size (or the cap) to be specified to prevent the list from over growing. Note that all write operations will execute immediately, whether a cap is specified or not - the list will always accept new items (trimming the tail after each insert in case of capped collections).
items.translation: RedisList 的默认实现。它不仅适用于列表，也适用于队列（FIFO 顺序）、栈（LIFO 顺序）以及双端队列。允许指定最大容量（或上限），以防止列表过度增长。请注意，无论是否设置了容量限制，所有写入操作都会立即执行——列表始终会接受新项（对于设置了容量限制的集合，每次插入后都会修剪尾部）。

items.source: Sets the maximum size of the (capped) list.
items.translation: 设置（封顶）列表的最大大小。

items.source: Sets the maximum size of the (capped) list. A value of 0 means unlimited.
items.translation: 设置（限制）列表的最大大小。值为 0 表示无限制。
